book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Sesoa Beswonam Nongalavna Noatatanam.
Doa Sesoava Noatatanam awothowol vena, aralm ishomnana, ombtowondpevoa yenaoa os towand vivra mindnam, verava, doa petham lehra vethara honam.
Tatamba tuawava mani mani, tambkova kava yem slowotunv, wo yenapenam si vinvra.
Pev vaohotho, tatalm hlavm. Seilva doara yimba osonnangas hlavna, men daipotava kava yemba tatamba wolamnav, hlao.
Mongongasalangas yemba kava ovunv, tatamba manam yimba hlavav tovolnahonamba, manara tovolnapopol tatamba av.
Yimba eva tovolnapopol avta, wo indhanariniva yemba mongova helvakomandhatava, si kava hemba kinwonda plothomnavav. Wo tatamba yemba winetava, kava miklevav.
Kav indhanamba vena, snal undna men kav avm, wo noinda henomba tovolva indhanarininamba kovhoatava, henamba eva indhanamba kuvhueivavta kana moara.
Doa yeoa otolmoa towand vivm mindnam, verava, petham honam lehra vetha.
Doa Sesoava Noatindim henga unna,
kam hillu, yem kava moa ishunv, yem, yetindim, henga si phovavm.
Tatamba eva kava ishunv, tuawam tatam manam manam, temba yimba wonpihanamba pevna botriniva.
Men kava yemba ishomnav, hengava si indhanamba tatamba kava kelvapiangavavmoa pueumbnamba. Pueumbva snamba si owai, hengava hona pethamba pueumbnamba si indkokla vrevavmoa.

Hello, mindva si kava kelathavav tekohovra, honamba osm, kav wohishomnav yem, tatam yunalm. Doa si kava tekomsna ningewol vevrava ovra, wo pom sombvramnavrava, hasvolm, wo mindva si os kelathavra snal.
Kava si os nonglavav, wo noinda yem ka vevra, nengmanavra os, doa kava wohishomnana, pueumbva hengava snamba si owai.
Wo hona mindva osm, men kav yem wohishomnanam, yem tatam, nom vavatannapopolm.
Noava Hevna Ombolm Ham Omnana, Yena Ombpovmba Sesoa Si Kin Plothomnavav.

Nihilva Noanamba ombtowondalnamba men, Sem Ham Yapet, botmerini aralva hemba wonpihanamba. Honamba Noana towandva samblamong pivna eindhumunil hona pethanindna annindna annindna indakonda. Hamba nomba Kenanna aral lohna.
Doa Noana andrava osondra, wo himba wolana weselmovpa di, os ningthiv grevmov. Indhanamba seilva doarava vinamoa.
Doa movolva ksuvhoavnamba, Noa pueitnamba, polm ve. Polm venamba, wainpolalm nilha, doa ne, noinda dai ona. Dai onamba, wo himba posal nihps livna talanahui hevna lailduvmera.
Doa Ham aralna lailduvra siha, aralm nonglana, pai nihps liv. Wo phonamba, unna, aramba nihps liv.
Wo Semi Yapeti kayen evranamba, aralm nona hehla evevrana. Doa hevna lura ehohlinna, os mumus epravna, aralmba enonglanamoa, mainovna ambo hehla evevrana.
Doa Noa henga pho, daiva wuleihanamba, hev hellena, kalelva os kamba yumona vlei, louwolmba!
Wo hev ona, Kenanmba Sesoa si kinsomb plothomnavav, Hamna ombolmba, wo Yapetina Semina keusingi si himba wohluhunvav.
Wo Semoa henamba mendekli Yawengas lohmanav, wo pioa Yawem nom okulivra. Semna keusingi si Kenamba wohlohvhoamnavav.
Wo Yapetoa hemoa Sesoa keknam poauothovra, osva hevtindiva mindnam si phovav, wo mongawulm euvmona vevra Semtindiva. Yapetna eva keusingi si Kenanmba lohmanavav.
Doa pueumbva nomba wohhivrapianamba, doa Noava hengava sism osomba vena 350pelara, os avna,
wo os wohdahana. Osomba hevnamba os lohmanavna 950pelara. Doata.
